pages.text: Right-click the wand in air to open your preset grid.$(br2)Left-click a preset to select it; right-click to edit. The $(bold)+$() tile creates one.$(br2)Click a container face to place a copy at the nearest free spot. Up to eight fit by default. Push sends from its host; Pull draws into it.

pages.title: Personal designs
pages.text: Paint, erase, and place separate item layers. Changes save automatically.

$(bold)Shift-right-click a glyph$() with the wand. Click containers to add targets; click again to remove. Up to 32 targets rotate.$(br2)A Relay or Nexus addresses its network. Colored beams show assigned routes and the aimed container while you hold the wand.$(br2)An unbound glyph emits matching particles. Shift-right-click air or a non-container block to finish. Assigned targets remain saved.
pages.title: Connect a rune
Connect several runes
pages.text: Shift-right-click a container first, then Shift-right-click Push or Pull glyphs to assign it to each one. The container stays selected. Click a glyph again to remove its assignment.$(br2)When you start from a glyph instead, Shift-right-clicking another glyph switches the selected rune. Shift-right-click air or a non-container block to finish.

pages.title: Placed copies
pages.text: Deleting or editing a preset leaves its placed copies unchanged.

Left-drag paints; right-drag erases. Ctrl+Z undoes a stroke.$(br2)$(bold)Color$() opens a wheel, brightness slider, and hex field. Painted colors stay exact; placed artwork is emissive.$(br2)Item overlays remain separate: drag to move, scroll to rotate, Shift-scroll to resize.
pages.title: Artwork controls
Choose a behavior
pages.text: The mode button cycles $(bold)Push / Pull / Filter$(). Left-click or scroll forward; right-click goes backward.$(br2)Filter needs no target. It restricts Astral deposits into its container and sets their priority.$(br2)Shift-left-click a glyph with anything to remove it.

pages.title: Keep a placed design
pages.text: Right-click a placed glyph with any item or an empty hand to open its settings.$(br2)$(bold)Save Preset$() copies its function, painted texture, and item overlays into a new preset. Its JSON file includes the artwork for sharing. The placed copy stays unchanged.$(br2)Preset edits never change copies already placed.
